scope: The standing Achimota School Administration Block in Accra, including its clock tower, arched main frontage and attached ranges.

originalReview.notes: The exact front view identifies the offset clock tower with flared metal crown, broad gabled central range, large entry arch, smaller ground-floor arches, dark shutters and wide forecourt stair.

quallaSearch.notes: The exact original was reviewed first in Qualla. Its initial Commons upload already identifies the photographer and states that it was taken on the uploader’s own camera, with an explicit PD-self release. The same native account uploaded the retained exact file. Other pictures showed separate buildings or grounds.
